column3: MT 41:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “the land” is rendered “the earth,” and the wish “may you not give him” “You will not deliver him.”
Close to the Hebrew; “all his bed you have turned” is rendered “You will sustain him on his sickbed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a thing of Belial” is rendered “An evil disease,” and NKJV supplies “they say.”
Close to the Hebrew; “has made great the heel” is rendered “Has lifted up his heel.”
